cluster_pattern.shape: C2: three claims' SOLE behavioural harm-advantage supports (ARC-007 via 114a, ARC-018 via 120a, Q-020 via 266b) each collapse below the 15% bar once selection is E3-routed, the episode budget is matched, and a static no-op control is present. Each prior support was a denominator artefact of a constant-action stream.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: The round-trip harm-navigation advantage does not survive a matched-budget, E3-routed, static-controlled redesign for ANY of the three claims -- a shared measurement artefact (constant-action denominator), not three independent mechanism failures. The mechanism CLASS existence-proof is intact; the behavioural translation to a harm advantage is what fails uniformly.
